props.gloss_en: R' Eliezer ben Yaakov: a large animal that expelled a mass of congealed blood -- it is buried
...and [the animal] is exempt from the firstborn
R' Chiyya teaches: it does not impart impurity, neither by contact nor by carrying
[it is buried] in order to publicize that she has been exempted from the firstborn
that is to say, it is a full-fledged offspring
R' Yochanan: because of nullification in the majority they touched upon it
R' Yochanan: R' Eliezer ben Yaakov and R' Shimon said one thing; R' Eliezer ben Yaakov's is what we said
the mishna: the afterbirth in the house -- the house is impure; not that the afterbirth is an offspring, but that there is no afterbirth without an offspring
R' Shimon: the offspring dissolved before it came out
